title: Blazing fast
content: Processes analytical queries faster than traditional row and column oriented systems.

title: Linearly scalable
content: Scales efficiently with hardware resources horizontally and vertically to petabyte scale.

title: Highly reliable
content: Supports asyncronous replication and can be deployed across multiple datacenters.

title: Flexible architecture
content: Supports shared-nothing clusters as well as separation of storage and compute.

title: Feature-rich
content: The most complete analytical database with support for joins, federated queries, and more.

title: Easy to use
content: Simplifies writing queries with a user-friendly SQL dialect, optimized for common analytical use cases.
